description.description: A capture of four frames showing Donald Trump greeting supporters in a restaurant setting. In the first and second frames, he is seen shaking hands and interacting with elderly patrons seated at a table, surrounded by his security and staff members. The third frame shows a group of diners at a round table, some taking photos with their phones, with a vintage-style tractor poster on the wall behind them. The fourth frame shows Trump walking through the restaurant aisle, past a man in a cowboy hat, as other patrons observe and take photos.
